caption: A car with its headlights on turns a corner at night, and the beams sweep across a row of parked cars.

sa.check: A car with its headlights on turns a corner at night.
The beams sweep across a row of parked cars.
Each parked car brightens as the beams cross it and darkens after.

pc.expect: Each parked car brightens as the beams cross it and darkens after, and the lit area moves with the turning car.
pc.fail: Cars stay lit after the beams pass; or brighten before; or the lit area stays put while the car turns.

pc.expect: The lit area moves only as the car moves.
pc.fail: It sweeps with the car stopped; or jumps; or moves the opposite way.

pc.expect: The beams are two cones from the headlights.
pc.fail: There are more; or one; or they are a flood in all directions.
One moves; or vanishes; or a car changes colour rather than brightness.

pc.expect: One moving car and the parked cars keep their number.
pc.fail: A parked car vanishes; or appears; or the moving car duplicates.
The buildings rearrange; or the road markings shift; or the cars change colour.
